up: List the distinct compounds from the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5726928 that have a canonical SMILES available. Show for each compound its ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), the preferred name (from molecule_dictionary.pref_name), and the canonical SMILES (from compound_structures.canonical_smiles). Only include compounds where canonical_smiles is not null. Use the docs table to filter by document (doc_id from compound_records), then join compound_records to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and left join compound_structures on molregno (but ensure canonical_smiles is present via a where condition). Return one row per distinct compound.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS chembl_id, md.pref_name AS pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5726928' AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL;
